things.name: the survey point at the Spire's base
a 1961 Army report: there was a Spire before
the depot ledger: the tanker that never came back
the 1902 sluice plans: the city was built to drown something
a child's drawing of the root, pinned in the belfry
the wedding party that won't stop dancing
the bell-ringer who has rung every hour for three days
the night librarian, still shelving by candlelight
a horde in the lab corridor
a horde in the substation lot

objective.text: Get out of the lab and reach the army

obstacle.text: A horde has filled the lab corridor.
A horde is pressing in on Harbor St outside the precinct.

subobjectives.text: Get the key from the sergeant's desk

obstacle.text: The checkpoint is about to be overrun; your rifle is all that holds it.

subobjectives.text: Order the barricade opened for the evacuation

destination.text: Get your passengers' message to the hospital

obstacle.text: A horde has filled Mill St in front of the bus lot.

subobjectives.text: Drive the No. 9 through the army barricade

obstacle.text: A horde is milling in the substation lot.

subobjectives.text: Unlock the substation control room for the crews

obstacle.text: A horde blocks Depot Rd toward the bridge.

subobjectives.text: Unlock the depot gate on your way out

objective.text: Get across the river to St. Agnes

obstacle.text: The Ash River Bridge is the short way home, and nobody knows if it will hold.

subobjectives.text: Key in the dispatch code at the depot gate

destination.text: Get your cut hand seen to

obstacle.text: The storm sewer is flooding and something moves in it.

subobjectives.text: Pry the maintenance hatch into the tunnels

objective.text: Get Milo from Linden Elementary and bring him home

obstacle.text: A horde has filled 1st Ave, and the school's front entrance is barricaded.

subobjectives.text: Pry open the school's back door off Linden Alley
Pry open the tunnel grate at the substation

objective.text: Get out of the lab and reach the army

obstacle.text: When the analyzer overloads, the main lab goes up in flames.

subobjectives.text: Run the signal through the analyzer

objective.text: Check on the array at Signal Hill

obstacle.text: The control room is locked, and only dispatch carries the key.

objective.text: Bring the ward's first-aid kit to the school shelter

obstacle.text: Smoke pours into the main stairwell.

subobjectives.text: Get the ward keys from the nurses' station
Run triage for the wounded in the plaza

objective.text: Make your last run to the fuel depot

obstacle.text: The Ash River Bridge gives way as you reach it.

subobjectives.text: Rig the tanker with the evidence-room flares

objective.text: Get your survey to the army

obstacle.text: The reading room's stairs are the only way down, and the street outside is not empty.

objective.text: Get to the library and write it all down

obstacle.text: Every way into the tunnels is shut until someone opens one.

subobjectives.text: Find what the Spire is rooted in

triggers.text: The analyzer's housing glows white and bursts. Fire races across the main lab.
The far span of the Ash River Bridge drops into the water.
Smoke pours down the main stairwell. Nobody is getting up that way now.
Inside the case, in foam: a rifle that hums.

milestones.name: The substation control room is open
The wounded are out of the plaza
The tanker is rigged to blow

optionals.name: The prototype pulse rifle
optionals.text: A courier never made it out. His case did.

optionals.name: Hale's observatory letters
optionals.text: She heard it once before, in 1979.

optionals.name: The night-shift tapes
optionals.text: The array has been answering for weeks.

optionals.name: The 1961 report
optionals.text: They blew the last one up. Read what grew back.

optionals.name: The depot ledger
optionals.text: Tanker 14, signed out to the Army, 1961. Never returned.

optionals.name: The 1902 sluice plans
optionals.text: The sluice was never for floods.

optionals.name: The child's drawing
optionals.text: Roots under the whole city, drawn in green crayon.

optionals.name: The wedding that won't stop
optionals.text: Celeste asks you to dance. The band hasn't noticed anything.

optionals.name: The bell-ringer
optionals.text: Father Amos rings the hour. He says someone has to.

optionals.name: The night librarian
optionals.text: Mrs. Ito stamps your card. Due back in a week.

endings.name: Contact
endings.text: Signal Hill answers the Spire. The hum stops. A new sound starts, one nobody has a word for yet.

endings.name: Destruction
endings.text: The tanker goes up at the Spire's base. When the smoke clears, the Spire is cracked and silent. So is half of downtown.

endings.name: Sever
endings.text: The sluice gates open and the river pours into the tunnels. Under the plaza, something drinks, and drowns, and lets go.
